data.body_html:
You've crossed the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2050. Your legs are shot, your shoulders ache from the swim, and all you want is to lie down. But here's the thing: the best recovery isn't a hotel bed – it's a boat. A [Marbella Ironman recovery boat charter](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-ironman-2050-recovery-charter/) from Puerto Banús lets you float your tired muscles in the Mediterranean, sip a cold drink, and let the sea do the healing. With prices from €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, it's an affordable luxury that your body will thank you for.

Why a yacht is the ultimate post-Ironman recovery

After 226km of swimming, cycling, and running, your body is inflamed. Gentle movement is key – and a boat provides exactly that. The constant, low-frequency rocking stimulates blood flow without impact, helping to flush lactic acid from your muscles. The saltwater spray reduces inflammation, while the sun boosts your vitamin D. Plus, the mental reset – away from race crowds and chip timers – is invaluable. You'll return to shore feeling lighter, calmer, and ready to celebrate.

Our recovery fleet: from compact to superyacht

We have a boat for every athlete and support crew. For a small group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect – both start at €749 for 2 hours. If you want more space and a free jet ski, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours. For larger parties, consider the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What's included in every charter

No hidden extras. Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your swimsuit and a towel. The skipper will handle everything – from navigating to anchoring in a calm cove. For the Mangusta 80, you also get a jet ski free, though we suggest saving that for day two.

Best recovery spots along the Costa del Sol

Your skipper knows the quiet spots. Head east to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés – sheltered coves with crystal-clear water, perfect for a gentle swim. Or cruise west towards Cabopino and Estepona, where you can anchor off sandy beaches. If you want to stay close, the bay off Río Verde offers calm waters with views of La Concha mountain. The choice is yours – just tell the skipper how you feel.

How to book your recovery charter

Booking is simple. Visit our [boat rental hub](/), choose your preferred boat, and send us a WhatsApp message with your date and group size. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. For Ironman week, we recommend booking at least a week in advance – the fleet fills up fast. Same-day bookings are possible if a boat is free, but don't risk it. Secure your spot and guarantee your recovery.

What to expect on board

Step aboard, and you'll be greeted with a chilled glass of cava or a soft drink. The skipper will give a quick safety briefing (though on a recovery day, it's more of a 'relax and enjoy' briefing). You can sunbathe on the foredeck, sit in the shade of the flybridge, or take a dip in the sea. Light snacks – think olives, crisps, and fresh fruit – are provided. After 2 hours, you'll feel like a new person. After 4, you'll be ready for a celebration dinner.
